external_methodology_constraints.imported_use: Weak mixing angle values depend on renormalization prescription, scale, and effective-angle convention; therefore B41 must declare the scheme before any physical comparison.
external_methodology_constraints.source: Particle Data Group, 2025 Electroweak Model and Constraints on New Physics review

external_methodology_constraints.imported_use: Precision physical comparison needs a declared loop order and benchmarkable beta-function convention.
external_methodology_constraints.source: Mihaila, Salomon, Steinhauser, Gauge Coupling Beta Functions in the Standard Model to Three Loops, arXiv:1201.5868

external_methodology_constraints.imported_use: Low-energy weak-angle running involves scheme-dependent higher-order and hadronic vacuum-polarization inputs; these cannot be replaced by an internal ratio alone.
external_methodology_constraints.source: Erler, Ferro-Hernandez, Kuberski, Theory Driven Evolution of the Weak Mixing Angle, CERN-TH-2024-071

K_phys_or_gauge_kinetic_matrix.description: A same-branch action normalization, equivalently a physical gauge kinetic matrix f_ab or K_phys in the same trace/action convention as the internal threshold vector.

RG_and_threshold_scheme.description: Declared perturbative order, renormalization scheme, active spectra, and threshold policy.

full_threshold_vector.description: Delta_a^sel beyond the already imported weak split, or a theorem that the missing threshold components vanish in the selected scheme.

mu_match.description: A selected matching surface before comparison to M_Z or any measured electroweak datum.
